snippet.title: Project Rabbit — Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
"Follow Alice into the abyss."

Project Rabbit is an Extraction Soulslike Action RPG inspired by a dark fantasy reimagining of Alice in Wonderland.

Fight, explore, and survive within the twisted echoes of time. Will you find the way out, or be consumed by the madness?

» Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4683260
» Official Website: http://www.nova-flare.com
